answer: Sybil resistance binds each agent identity to an enclave’s MRENCLAVE, the cryptographic measurement of its code, verified through remote hardware attestation. A hollow VM clone cannot reproduce a genuine enclave attestation by copying files or duplicating virtual machines; creating another valid instance requires access to additional physical silicon. The attestation signal establishes the measured code and hardware provenance, while “sable” may serve as an agent label, not a security property.
